name: Oniyome: Oni Musume o Yome ni Moratte Nakadashi Haramase Kozukuri
original_name: おによめ 鬼娘を嫁にもらって中出し孕ませ子作り
source:
Kakurezumi Village is a hidden settlement inhabited solely by beautiful, kind-hearted, and free-spirited oni girls—a place beyond the realm of humans.
Men who stumble into this village from the outside world are called marebito (rare visitors) and are allowed to take any of the village’s girls as their bride.
Oniyome—the brides of oni.
Renowned since ancient times as the ideal wives, they are said to be unmatched in beauty and virtue, treasures no amount of gold could ever buy.

Sora, a young man with no family or ties to the world, fell while hiking and found himself transported across time and space.
He was rescued by Okinu, the village chief of Kakurezumi.

"I’m afraid I don’t know how to send you back to your world. For now, live here in the village and take a wife."

And so began Sora’s new life in Kakurezumi Village.
But which of the oni girls would he choose as his oniyome?..

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/oniyome/index.html#story]the official website[/url]]
translation:
角住村是一个隐藏的聚居地，居住着美丽、善良、自由的鬼女孩——一个超越人类领域的地方。
从外界偶然来到这个村庄的男人被称为“marebito”（稀有访客），他们可以娶村里的任何女孩为新娘。
Oniyome——鬼的新娘。
她们自古被誉为贤妻良母，据说美德无双，是千金难买的珍宝。

索拉是一个没有家庭、与世界没有联系的年轻人，他在徒步旅行时摔倒，发现自己穿越了时空。
被角积村长冲怒所救。

“我恐怕不知道怎么送你回你的世界，现在就住在村子里，娶个老婆吧。”

空在角积村的新生活就这样开始了。
但他会选择哪个鬼女孩作为他的鬼女呢？

[翻译自[url=http://clockup.net/oniyome/index.html#story]官网[/url]]
